# Finance Intelligence Platform - Quantitative Architecture & LLM Index

> Finance Intelligence Platform (FT) is an institutional-grade quantitative analytics, congressional stock trading intelligence, and macroeconomic risk engine designed for retail traders and quantitative analysts.

## Platform Capabilities & Documentation

- **Live Terminal**: https://finance-xp8.pages.dev/
- **User Guide & Quantitative Methodologies**: https://finance-xp8.pages.dev/guide/
- **Private Portfolio & Risk Allocations**: https://finance-xp8.pages.dev/portfolio/
- **Hidden Gems Screener**: https://finance-xp8.pages.dev/screener/
- **Asset Comparison Matrix**: https://finance-xp8.pages.dev/compare/
- **Smart Money & Congressional Disclosures**: https://finance-xp8.pages.dev/smart-money/

## Core Quantitative Engines & Methodologies

1. **Smart Money Intelligence**:
   - Tracking legislative transactions under the 2012 Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge (STOCK) Act (Public Law 112-105).
   - Unusual Options Flow & Institutional Block Sweeps tracking OPRA & FINRA ATS Dark Pool volumes.
   - Committee Assignment & Jurisdiction Overlap analysis.

2. **Algorithmic Execution & Volatility Sizing**:
   - Mark Minervini 3-Stage Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP) for growth and swing accumulation.
   - Linda Raschke 20-period Exponential Moving Average (20 EMA) pullback model for intraday momentum.
   - 14-period Turtle Average True Range (ATR) trailing stop-loss and dual take-profit ladders (Target 1 Scale + Target 2 Runner).

3. **Risk Management & Macroeconomic Modeling**:
   - Cornish-Fisher Modified Value-at-Risk (M-VaR 95% and 99%) adjusting for skewness and fat-tailed kurtosis.
   - Piotroski 9-Point F-Score fundamental health evaluation.
   - Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) yield curve (10Y-2Y spread) macro regime analysis.
